scientific_integrity: Mathematical idealization, not an empirical prescription; numerical test coverage is finite and is secondary to the analytic argument; historical priority is best-knowledge and not certified.
scientific_limitations: One transient episode; perfectly observed positive overlap, no false positives; equal known exponential arrival and exit rates; predetermined same-length windows; no end deadline, travel or switching cost; window duration fixed rather than optimized; no independent empirical validation.
title: Fixed-duration transient-episode monitoring has a sharp algebraic-to-exponential detection transition
